In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of supersymmetric gauge theory in 5-dimensional space-time.
understanding the geometry of the moduli space of vacua in N=2 supersymmetric gauge theories, and its relation to the geometry of the corresponding toric Sasaki- Einstein manifolds.
the computation of the 5D super-Yang-Mills partition functions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the perturbatively exact partition function of 5D SYM on simply connected tori Sasaki-Einstein manifolds is given by the product of n full Nekrasav partition functions, where n is the number of sides of the polygon base of the toric moment map cone.

the perturbatively localised Nekrasov instanton partition function on simply connected torically specified Sasaki-Einstein manifolds is given by gluing the full Nekarasov partition function of 4d N=2 super Yang-Mills.

the complete partition function for 5D super-Yang-Mills theory on a simply connected Sasaki-Einstein manifold with toric diagram of n-gon shape factorises into n copies of the perturbative Nekrasov's partition function, with the coupling constant and the instanton counting parameters of the i-th copy being the i-th root of the coupling constant and instanton counting parameters, respectively.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the partition function of 5D SYM on a simply connected toric SE manifold with pentagon, hexagon, etc base is given by gluing Nekraso partition functions of 4D SYM on the corresponding toric Calabi-Yau manifolds.

we have shown that the localisation computation of 5D SYM on toric SE manifolds with pentagon, hexagon, etc. base is governed by the combintatorial data of the torus action on the manifolds, in particular the combinatorics of the toric diagrams.
the perturbatrive partition function on a toric Sasaki manifold factorises to the Nekrasvov partition function on the corresponding toric Calabi-Yau cone.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we provide an algorithm for computing Nekrasov functions for any simply connected toric manifold.
the combinatorics of the toric data encodes a great deal of the information about the partition function.
the perturbatively exact partition function of 5D SYM on simply connected SE manifolds is given by a product of n copies of the complete Nekrasov function.
